verdict.rationale: The axis applies because ReelMimic can publish videos to live social platforms, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question. The only related evidence is a dry-run mode for post-video that previews what would be posted. A dry run is a preview, not an isolated sandbox environment to test against, so it earns no credit. Running locally with your own Claude Code or Codex is likewise not a sandbox separated from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
